message: The other day, as the wind howled and the rain pelted against my windows, I found myself feeling unusually calm. I had finally become the prepared one in my family! I had my trusty supply kit tucked away, candles at the ready, and enough snacks to start a small convenience store. It felt nice to know I wasn’t just waiting for the storm to pass, but rather ready to ride it out with a bit of comfort. Who knew preparedness could feel this cozy? ☔️
